external_games.name: Rat Quest - The Quest For Swiss

name: Rat Quest: The Quest For Swiss
summary:
After you devoured the cheddar, your appetite knows no bounds, and no satiation. You must now get... THE SWISSIn an all new level you must jump, dash, wall jump, parry, spin jump, and double dash to get to the top!

Wall Jump:You can now jump off walls without burning your jumps!

Parry:There's a new interactable called the parry orb that you can now parry off of to gain extra height!

Spin Jump:Use the spin jump ability to gain a little extra height on a jump without overdoing it!

Double Dash:After buying this ability you can dash not once, but twice!!

Use all this and more to climb to the top, of LEVEL 2
